mapper.select: SELECT initialized, timezone, slow_url_ms, slow_sql_ms, slow_call_ms, slow_cache_ms, initialized_at FROM nc_platform_profile WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE nc_platform_profile SET initialized = #{initialized}, timezone = #{timezone}, slow_url_ms = #{slowUrlMs}, slow_sql_ms = #{slowSqlMs}, slow_call_ms = #{slowCallMs}, slow_cache_ms = #{slowCacheMs}, initialized_at = #{initializedAt} WHERE id = 1
mapper.select: SELECT channel, enabled, config_json FROM nc_channel_config ORDER BY channel
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nc_channel_config (channel, enabled, config_json) VALUES (#{channel}, #{enabled}, #{configJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), config_json = VALUES(config_json)
